description: Pre-merge public Synthesis service method inventory (136) with a per-method disposition against the audited current production operation roster. Source-fixed inventory. A disposition records an approval or an owner candidate; it does not assert behavioral equivalence.

priorBaseline.note: Earlier independent identity retained as the existing observable fixture baseline. Its 131 methods are a strict subset of this 136-method baseline; the 5 additions are listed in baselineDelta.addedAfterPriorBaseline.

pendingRestoration.note: The captured roster is the audited 106-operation identity at this commit. The auditConceptAliases restoration is expected to raise the roster to 107; that operation is not in this captured roster and is recorded as an unresolved baseline method.

approvalSource.scopeNote: The 23 authorized retirements and the merged / host_capability dispositions are taken verbatim from this historical migration SSOT, which was authored against the 131-method e210997a baseline. This fixture does not extend that authorization to the 5 methods added after that baseline.

statusVocabulary.same_name_not_yet_behavior_proven: A same-named current production operation exists. Name identity only; no behavioral equivalence is asserted and no executable parity evidence is attached.
statusVocabulary.owner_candidate_unverified: A current semantic owner or capability is recorded from the historical migration SSOT. Ownership stays a candidate until consumer-migration evidence is verified.
statusVocabulary.approved_retirement: The method name appears verbatim in audit.deletion_authorization of the historical migration SSOT.
statusVocabulary.unknown: No current production operation and no recorded disposition could be verified.

pointerSources.NOTE_NO_VERIFIED_CURRENT_PRODUCER: no verified current producer; not in the captured production roster; not in deletion_authorization
pointerSources.NOTE_NOT_IN_ROSTER_AND_NO_SSOT_DISPOSITI: not present in the captured production roster and no disposition recorded in the migration SSOT

evidenceClasses.source_inspection: Baseline method list, current roster list, and the approval list were each read from fixed source identities.
